title: How to Cancel Notion — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel your Notion Plus or Business subscription. Downgrade to the free plan without losing your pages. Step-by-step with screenshots.
intro: Notion's cancellation is actually a 'downgrade to free' — and the good news is you keep all your pages and data. The free plan is genuinely usable for personal use.

steps.title: Open Notion Settings
steps.text: Click "Settings & Members" in the left sidebar of your Notion workspace, or navigate directly to notion.so/my-account.

steps.title: Go to the Plans section
steps.text: In the Settings panel, click "Plans" or "Subscription" in the left menu. You'll see your current plan details and billing info.

steps.title: Click "Downgrade" or "Cancel plan"
steps.text: Click the "Downgrade" button under your current plan. Notion will show a comparison of what you'll lose (unlimited file uploads, version history beyond 7 days, etc.).
steps.tip: If you're the workspace owner with team members, downgrading affects everyone. Consider exporting critical data first.

steps.title: Confirm the downgrade
steps.text: Select your reason for canceling and click "Downgrade to Free". Your paid features remain active until the end of your billing period, then you switch to the free tier.
steps.tip: The free plan includes unlimited pages and blocks. You only lose file upload size (5MB limit), version history (7 days), and guest limits.

warnings: Files larger than 5MB won't be accessible for editing on the free plan (you can still view/download them).
Version history is limited to 7 days on free (vs 30 days on Plus). Export important version history before downgrading.
If you're on a Team/Business plan, all workspace members will be affected by the downgrade.
Automations beyond basic ones will be disabled on the free tier.

faqs.q: Will I lose my Notion pages if I cancel?
faqs.a: No. All your pages, databases, and content are preserved on the free plan. You keep unlimited pages and blocks. The free plan is genuinely usable for personal productivity.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Notion?
faqs.a: Notion offers refunds on a case-by-case basis. Contact team@makenotion.com within a few days of charge. They're generally responsive to refund requests for recent charges.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Notion Free and Plus?
faqs.a: Free gives you unlimited pages/blocks but with 5MB file upload limit, 7-day version history, and limited guests. Plus ($10/mo) adds unlimited file uploads, 30-day history, and unlimited guests.

faqs.q: Can I export all my Notion data before canceling?
faqs.a: Yes. Go to Settings → Export all workspace content. You'll get a ZIP file with your pages in HTML or Markdown format, plus any uploaded files.

refund.details: Notion handles refunds on a case-by-case basis. Email team@makenotion.com with your request. They're generally willing to refund recent charges, especially if you haven't used the paid features extensively.

retentionTactics: Notion shows a comparison table of Free vs Plus features to highlight what you'll lose.
They may offer a discounted annual plan if you're on monthly billing.
